answer_1.quote: Preference alignment optimizes LLMs using feedback that reflects human preferences. Given an oracle safety reward r*, the goal of safety alignment is to ensure that for any response pair y_i, y_j generated by aligned policy π_θ with prompt x, it holds that π_θ(y_i|x) > π_θ(y_j|x) only if r*(y_i) > r*(y_j).

answer_2.quote: We assess safety through toxicity rate, using redteam prompts as model inputs. Llama-guard-2 model and MD-Judge are chosen as the evaluation models.

answer_3.quote: Llama-guard-2 model and MD-Judge are chosen as the evaluation models. MD-Judge serves as a classifier to evaluate the safety of question-answer pairs.
